name: Pristimantis paganus

sections: morphology
Type material has unresolved catalogue duplication
模式材料存在未解决的编号重复

The diagnosis reports adult male SVL 17.20–21.5 mm (n=13) and female SVL 24.8–29.8 mm (n=6), separately from female holotype DHMECN 16810 at 27.23 mm. The paratype paragraph says six females, thirteen males and three juveniles but repeats some specimen numbers among these categories, including 15596, 15599 and 15603. Its listing therefore cannot independently certify the exact unique sex/age denominator without the collection and supplementary tables.
诊断报告成年雄性吻肛长 17.20–21.5 毫米（n=13）、雌性 24.8–29.8 毫米（n=6），另列雌正模 DHMECN 16810 为 27.23 毫米。副模段称六雌、十三雄、三幼体，但在类别间重复若干编号，包括 15596、15599、15603；未核查馆藏及补表前，清单不能独立认证准确的唯一性别／年龄分母。
appearance
Sex and preservation affect appearance
性别与保存影响外观

Females are described with predominantly black backs and dark markings on a cream to pink-cream underside, whereas males have orange-brown backs and scapular W/inverted-V markings. Dorsolateral folds are weak and discontinuous in females, continuous in males. Preserved colour is described separately from live colour. The diagnosis reports no vocal slits, sac or nuptial pad; this does not prove that the species is silent.
雌性主要黑背，乳白至粉乳白腹面带暗纹；雄性橙褐背，肩胛有 W／倒 V 纹。雌背侧褶较弱、不连续，雄较连续。保存颜色与活体颜色分别描述。诊断称无声裂、声囊及婚垫，不能证明本种不鸣叫。
ecology
Two montane localities and bounded reproductive evidence
两个山地地点及有限繁殖证据

The account records Colonso Chalupas and Cerro de Abitagua sites about 50 km apart, at reported elevations 2157–2500 m. Frogs were observed at 22:00–01:00 on leaf litter and vegetation up to 120 cm above ground in primary cloud forest. A gravid female supports reproductive condition, not observed oviposition, clutch size or full direct-development timing. The holotype paragraph dates collection to 24 November 2021 whereas natural history describes its observation on 21 November; this is retained without inferring a capture-history correction.
记述记录 Colonso Chalupas 与 Cerro de Abitagua 两地，相距约 50 千米，所报海拔 2157–2500 米。蛙于 22:00–01:00 见于原生云雾林落叶及离地至 120 厘米植被。怀卵雌性支持繁殖状态，不是产卵观察、窝卵数或完整直接发育时序。正模段写 2021 年 11 月 24 日采集，自然史则写 21 日观察，分别保留，不推断捕获历史修正。
evolution
Candidate lineages are not accepted species counts
候选支系不是接受物种计数

The proposed Cryptomantis framework contains nine described names including paganus and five unconfirmed candidate lineages. Paganus clusters with marcoreyesi and candidate 2 with reported bootstrap support 98. Reported paganus–marcoreyesi 16S p-distance fractions 0.024–0.031 correspond to 2.4–3.1%, not 0.024–0.031 percent. Candidate thresholds vary in the study and are not universal species definitions. Molecular methods target three mitochondrial loci and RAG1 using Sanger and nanopore amplicons, not whole genomes.

拟议 Cryptomantis 框架含九个描述名称（含 paganus）及五个未确认候选支系。paganus 与 marcoreyesi、候选 2 聚类，所报自举支持 98。paganus–marcoreyesi 的 16S p 距离小数 0.024–0.031 对应 2.4–3.1%，不是 0.024–0.031%。文内候选阈值不一，不是通用物种定义。分子方法以 Sanger、纳米孔扩增子处理三个线粒体位点及 RAG1，不是全基因组。
conservation
A dated Near Threatened proposal
有年代的近危建议

The authors propose Near Threatened on the basis of few recorded localities, infrequent encounters and potential threats. The figure of fewer than 25 encounters during stated sampling is not a population census. Illegal mining, deforestation and climate change are discussed as potential threats, not measured current declines. Presence inside protected areas does not certify demographic viability or protection effectiveness; this proposal is not a newly verified official IUCN category.
作者依据少量记录地点、低频遇见及潜在威胁，提议近危。所述取样期间少于 25 次遇见不是种群普查。非法采矿、毁林、气候变化讨论为潜在威胁，不是测定的当前下降。保护地内存在不能认证种群动态存续或保护有效性；建议不是新核实的官方 IUCN 等级。
